tooltips.kind: Where events come from. Website/Mobile ingest through the public (unsigned) path; Server/Chat/Other are server-to-server and require a signing secret. CRM (Internal) enables tracking of events the CRM emits about itself (e.g. Opportunity stage changes): create one CRM source per tenant to turn it on — it never ingests over HTTP, and deactivating it turns internal tracking off.
tooltips.ingestUrl: Public URL to POST events to. The path id is the row id — anyone with this URL can attempt ingestion, so always set a signing secret for production sources.
tooltips.trackerSnippet: Paste this snippet into your site's <head> (every page you want tracked). It loads the tracker asynchronously and sends a page_view on load. Track custom events with mstx('track', 'event_code', {...}); identify visitors with mstx('identify', email). The page's origin must be listed in Allowed Origins.
tooltips.signingSecret: HMAC-SHA256 secret used to verify the X-Tracking-Signature header. Required for trusted kinds (Server, Chat, Other); not used for Website/Mobile — browsers cannot keep secrets. Stored encrypted; write-only (never readable back through the API).
tooltips.identityVerificationSecret: Optional secret for verified identify() calls from public sources. Your backend signs the visitor's email with HMAC-SHA256 and the browser SDK sends the signature in the event body — identity claims without a valid signature are treated as unverified. Stored encrypted; write-only.
tooltips.allowedOrigins: One CORS origin per line (e.g. https://www.example.com). Required for kind=Website — browser ingestion is rejected unless the Origin header matches. Not applicable to other kinds.
tooltips.allowUnknownEventCode: If true, ingestion auto-creates a TrackingEventType (category=Custom) for unknown codes. Turn off once your event dictionary stabilises.
tooltips.rateLimitPerMinute: Maximum ingest requests per minute for this source (best-effort fixed window). 0 = unlimited. Public sources are additionally rate-limited per client IP.
tooltips.lastEventError: Last non-success status reason. Updated on every ingest attempt regardless of outcome.
tooltips.tenant: Derived from the first selected team via Tenant.baseUserTeam. Set automatically by the AssignTenantFromTeam hook — assign teams to populate this.
